BadRequestProblem.description: The request is malformed or fails validation.

ConflictProblem.description: The request conflicts with the current resource or run state.

ForbiddenProblem.description: The authenticated identity lacks the required permission.

InternalServerErrorProblem.description: The server could not complete the request.

NotFoundProblem.description: The requested resource does not exist or is not visible.

TooManyRequestsProblem.description: The request is throttled after repeated authentication failures.

UnauthorizedProblem.description: Authentication is required or credentials are invalid.

get.description: Returns durable audit events matching optional actor, action, resource, and UTC time filters. ADMIN is required.

parameters.description: Actor user identifier. System actors do not have a user identifier.
parameters.name: actorUserId

parameters.description: Inclusive lower event timestamp bound in UTC ISO-8601 date-time format.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Exclusive upper event timestamp bound in UTC ISO-8601 date-time format.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Requested page size, clamped to the range 1 through 200.
parameters.name: size

get.description: Initializes the XSRF-TOKEN cookie and returns the framework header and parameter names. Call this public endpoint before protected state-changing requests.

post.description: Authenticates a user and establishes the server-owned session. Login is public and exempt from CSRF, but database-backed throttling limits repeated failures by account and source address.

200.description: Authenticated identity returned and session established

post.description: Invalidates the current server session and clears its security context. The session cookie and CSRF header are required.

get.description: Returns the user identifier, username, and global role associated with the current session.
Aggregates only jobs visible to the authenticated identity. Omitted bounds produce an effective 24-hour window ending at the current server time; from must be before to.

parameters.description: Optional inclusive window start in UTC ISO-8601 date-time format. Defaults to 24 hours before the effective end.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Optional exclusive window end in UTC ISO-8601 date-time format. Defaults to current server time.
parameters.name: to

get.description: Returns only visible profiles. The optional role filter selects connector source or sink capability; it is not a user-role filter.

parameters.description: Requested page size, clamped to the range 1 through 200.
parameters.name: size

post.description: Creates an encrypted datasource profile after validating its connector scheme. Responses expose only redacted connection metadata. ADMIN and CSRF are required.

get.description: Returns grants grouped by user. ADMIN is required.

delete.description: Removes all datasource grants for one user. ADMIN and CSRF are required.

put.description: Atomically replaces one user's VIEW, USE, and EDIT grant set. ADMIN and CSRF are required.

delete.description: Deletes an unreferenced datasource. ADMIN and CSRF are required; profiles bound to jobs return a conflict.

get.description: Returns redacted profile metadata and capability flags after VIEW permission. Stored security values are never rehydrated in the response.

put.description: Updates a profile after EDIT permission. Omitted or blank security inputs preserve stored encrypted values; clearSecurityKeys explicitly removes named values. CSRF is required.

get.description: Returns only jobs visible to the authenticated identity. Pagination defaults to page 0 and size 50; size is clamped to 1 through 200.

parameters.description: Requested page size, clamped to the range 1 through 200.
parameters.name: size

post.description: Creates a job after validating datasource USE access, connector roles, mode support, and single-job limits. Protected mutations require the session cookie and CSRF header.

delete.description: Deletes an inactive job and its dependent history after unscheduling it. ADMIN is required; active runs cause a conflict. Protected mutations require the session cookie and CSRF header.

get.description: Returns one job definition when the authenticated identity has VIEW permission. Datasource summaries are omitted when their metadata is not visible.

put.description: Replaces editable job settings after EDIT permission and datasource capability checks. The job name is immutable. Protected mutations require the session cookie and CSRF header.

get.description: Returns grants grouped by user after EDIT permission on the job.

delete.description: Removes all job grants for one user after EDIT permission. CSRF is required.

put.description: Atomically replaces one user's VIEW, EDIT, EXECUTE, and CANCEL grants after EDIT permission. CSRF is required.

get.description: Returns run history for one job after VIEW permission. Status values are case-insensitive; paging defaults to page 0 and size 50 with a size cap of 200.

parameters.description: Optional repeated run statuses: PENDING, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCEL_REQUESTED, CANCELLED, or RETRY_SCHEDULED.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Inclusive lower timestamp bound in UTC ISO-8601 date-time format.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Exclusive upper timestamp bound in UTC ISO-8601 date-time format.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Requested page size, clamped to the range 1 through 200.
parameters.name: size

post.description: Creates or replays one pending manual run after EXECUTE permission. The idempotency key is scoped to manual trigger requests and remains replay-safe within the server retention window. Protected mutations require the session cookie and CSRF header.

parameters.description: Required non-blank key for replay-safe manual triggering; maximum 255 characters.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

202.description: Run accepted or an existing idempotent result replayed

delete.description: Removes the persisted schedule and Quartz trigger after EDIT permission. Repeated deletion is idempotent. Protected mutations require the session cookie and CSRF header.

get.description: Returns the recurring schedule and next fire time after VIEW permission. A job without a schedule returns not found.

put.description: Validates and stores the Quartz CRON schedule after EDIT permission, then reconciles the durable scheduler trigger. Blank time zones default to UTC. Protected mutations require the session cookie and CSRF header.
put.summary: Create or replace a job schedule

post.description: Re-encrypts one bounded batch using the current key version. Repeat until remaining is zero. ADMIN and CSRF are required.

parameters.description: Maximum number of envelopes to process in this request.
parameters.name: batchSize

schema.description: Maximum number of envelopes to process in this request.

get.description: Returns known key versions and encrypted datasource envelope counts without key material. ADMIN is required.
Returns runs only for jobs visible to the authenticated identity, with optional status and UTC time bounds.

parameters.description: Optional repeated run statuses: PENDING, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCEL_REQUESTED, CANCELLED, or RETRY_SCHEDULED.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Inclusive lower timestamp bound in UTC ISO-8601 date-time format.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Exclusive upper timestamp bound in UTC ISO-8601 date-time format.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Requested page size, clamped to the range 1 through 200.
parameters.name: size

get.description: Returns durable state and attempt information after VIEW permission on the owning job.

post.description: Cancels pending work or persists cancellation intent for a running attempt after CANCEL permission. The response includes a mode-specific sink warning. Protected mutations require the session cookie and CSRF header.

get.description: Returns the credential-redacted, size-bounded log after VIEW permission. A run without captured output returns an empty log response.

post.description: Creates a new pending attempt linked to the failed run after EXECUTE permission. Retry restarts from the beginning and is not resume behavior. Protected mutations require the session cookie and CSRF header.

get.description: Returns the ADMIN-visible user catalog with zero-based pagination.

parameters.description: Requested page size, clamped to the range 1 through 200.
parameters.name: size

post.description: Creates an enabled user with an ADMIN, OPERATOR, or VIEWER role. The password is accepted only for hashing and is never returned. ADMIN and CSRF are required.

get.description: Returns one user's public identity, global role, and enabled state. ADMIN is required.

put.description: Replaces the global role and enabled state without changing username or password. ADMIN and CSRF are required.
put.summary: Update a user's role and state

put.description: Hashes and replaces the target user's password without returning it or requiring the old value. ADMIN and CSRF are required.
